NUTRITION
  ENERGY:
    guideline "Breastfeeding support: maintenance calories + 300..500 kcal/day; avoid aggressive deficits until milk supply stable"
  PROTEIN:
    guideline "1.6..2.0 g/kg bodyweight daily; include protein at each meal/snack"
  CARBOHYDRATE:
    guideline "3..5 g/kg bodyweight daily; time carbs around feeds and workouts for energy"
  FAT:
    guideline "Minimum 0.8 g/kg bodyweight; include omega-3 sources 2..3x/week"
  FLUIDS:
    guideline "Baseline 35..45 ml/kg/day + 700..1000 ml for lactation; drink to thirst and add 300..500 ml during/after workouts"
  MICRONUTRIENTS:
    guideline "Continue prenatal/multivitamin per OB; emphasize calcium 1000 mg, vitamin D 600..2000 IU, iodine 150 mcg, choline 450 mg, iron per labs"
  MEAL_STRUCTURE:
    guideline "3 meals + 2..3 snacks; include protein, complex carbs, produce, and healthy fats each time"
  PRE_WORKOUT:
    guideline "Light snack 30..60 min pre: 20..30 g carbs + 10..20 g protein; hydrate 300..500 ml water"
  POST_WORKOUT:
    guideline "Within 1 hour: 25..35 g protein + 30..60 g carbs; add fluids and electrolytes"
  LACTATION_SUPPORT:
    guideline "Monitor milk supply and infant cues; if supply dips, increase fluids, add 200 kcal/day, reduce training load, and consult OB/LC"
  FOODS_TO_LIMIT:
    guideline "Alcohol; high-mercury fish; excessive caffeine (>300 mg/day); strongly flavored foods only as tolerated by infant"
  ALLERGIES_INTOLERANCES:
    guideline "Adjust fiber, dairy, soy, or other potential triggers based on infant GI response; reintroduce gradually"
  EXAMPLE_DAY:
    guideline "Breakfast: oatmeal + milk, chia, berries, peanut butter; Snack: Greek yogurt + fruit; Lunch: whole-grain wrap with chicken, avocado, veggies; Snack: hummus + carrots + crackers; Dinner: salmon, quinoa, roasted veggies; Before bed: cottage cheese + kiwi"
  NOTES:
    guideline "Prioritize easy-to-prep meals; keep snacks near nursing station; aim for gentle weekly weight change only after 8..12 weeks if supply stable"
  CAUTION:
    guideline "Stop or regress any movement that causes pain, pressure, doming/coning, urinary leakage, or incision discomfort; consult OB/physio if symptoms persist"
